scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm build:replay && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web dev
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/web/tests apps/web/drizzle.config.ts apps/web/playwright.auth.config.ts apps/web/playwright.reports.config.ts apps/web/playwright.standard.config.ts apps/web/playwright.projects.config.ts apps/web/playwright.report-restart.config.ts packages/contracts/src packages/sdk/src packages/test-plan/src tests playwright.config.ts playwright.sdk.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/sdk typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm build:replay && corepack pnpm posters:check && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web build
scripts.test:reports: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm build:replay && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web test:reports
scripts.test:report-restart: corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web exec playwright test --config playwright.report-restart.config.ts
scripts.build:packages: corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/sdk build && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/test-plan build
scripts.test:sdk: corepack pnpm build:packages && node scripts/build-sdk-smoke.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.sdk.config.ts
scripts.test:motion: corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web exec playwright test --config playwright.auth.config.ts motion.spec.ts
scripts.test:projects: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm build:replay && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web exec playwright test --config playwright.projects.config.ts
scripts.test:plans: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm build:replay && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web exec playwright test --config playwright.reports.config.ts test-plan.spec.ts
scripts.test:standard: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm build:replay && node scripts/build-standard-sites.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter @unravel/web exec playwright test --config playwright.standard.config.ts
